verdict_statement: #90 canonical interval-mean mm/h rate resources cannot directly populate the two precipitation members consumed by pinned FLEXPART 11.1 interpol_rain with numpf=1. Those members are flex_extract RRINT=0 darain reconstructions of the precipitation rate at the member timestamp, built from four neighbouring interval means. The reconstruction operation is missing (#207).
validation_level: execution of unmodified pinned flex_extract EcFlexpart.deacc_fluxes on a declared finite accumulated-GRIB example
direct original-routine oracle (unchanged pinned interpol_rain via scripts/interpolation/direct_oracle.sh)
not_claimed: full readwind_ecmwf execution on a complete FLEXPART input file (prepared GRIB keys are decoded with the same ecCodes keys the reader requests)
ERA5 class EA, PUREFC=1, BASETIME, RRINT=1 or numpf=3 suitability

preprocessing_path.tool: flex_extract 7.1.2 (Python), the preparation tool named by reference/flex-extract.json
preprocessing_path.flux_padding: get_mars_data.py:299-301 retrieves flux data one day before START_DATE and one day after END_DATE for PUREFC=0 unless BASETIME=0, so every member in the requested period has complete four-interval support.
preprocessing_path.output_assembly: EcFlexpart.py:1739-1765 concatenates flux<YYYYMMDDHH> for time T into the FLEXPART input file <PREFIX><YYMMDDHH> for the same T.

source_chain.member: LSP (paramId 142) and CP (paramId 143), steps DTIME..ACCMAXSTEP by DTIME from forecast bases ACCTIME

source_chain.representation: interval-mean rate; first step after a base uses the base-relative accumulation, later steps difference consecutive steps; class EA is never differenced
reconstructed precipitation rate at the interval boundary T, documented as the point used for subsequent linear interpolation
source_chain.physical_interval: support [T - 2*DTIME, T + 2*DTIME]; value attributed to the instant T
source_chain.validity_time: T = end of x_k = start of x_{k+1}
source_chain.transformation: clip each x below 0 to 0; xac = xb*xc/(xa+xc) if xa+xc > 0 else 0.5*xb; xbd = xb*xc/(xb+xd) if xb+xd > 0 else 0.5*xc; member = xac + xbd

source_chain.routine: EcFlexpart.deacc_fluxes, EcFlexpart.py:1201-1211 (file named by t_m2dt = T)
source_chain.member: flux<YYYYMMDDHH of T>, one message per parameter

source_chain.representation: unchanged prepared value stored as real4; GRIB1 CP conversion_factor = 1
source_chain.memory_time: wftime from the AVAILABLE entry of the file (readoptions_mod.f90 readavailable); the GRIB date/time is never read or checked

source_chain.member: memind(1), memind(2) with memtime(1) <= itime < memtime(2)
source_chain.memory_time: memtime(i) = wftime of the loaded file = T of its member

source_chain.member: submember ip=1 of memind(1) and memind(2)
source_chain.representation: (r0*dt2 + r1*dt1)/dtt with dtt = dt/3, evaluated at the unshifted itime

rrint_numpf_relationship.proven: FLEXPART 11.1 numpf=1 accepts exactly the flex_extract RRINT=0 representation (one LSP and one CP message per file, stepRange 0 -> ipf 1).
rrint_numpf_relationship.rrint1: RRINT=1 writes six precipitation messages per file with stepRange 0, 1 and 2 (EcFlexpart.py:1411-1458, observed: 6 messages per file). readwind_ecmwf stops when more than two precipitation fields are present and numpf=1 (windfields_mod.f90:541-548). RRINT=1 is therefore unusable with numpf=1.
rrint_numpf_relationship.purefc: PUREFC=1 sets stepRange = max(0, step - 2*DTIME) on precipitation members (EcFlexpart.py:1204-1205), which the reader maps to ipf > 1. Rejected; not executed.

dt_over_3.pinned_formula: dt1 = itime - memtime(1); dt2 = memtime(2) - itime; dt = memtime(2) - memtime(1); dtt = dt/3; result = (r0*dt2 + r1*dt1)/dtt
dt_over_3.provenance: Introduced in FLEXPART commit c655930217a164cebfa0c5397636fbfa9e856d60 (2023-07-12, ticket #295, numpf=3 precipitation sub-fields). Before it, v10.4 interpol_rain returned y1(1) without temporal interpolation and the pre-#295 v11 wetdepo used the nearer memory. dtt is the numpf=3 sub-interval width: in each numpf=3 branch dtp1 + dtp2 = dtt (interpol_mod.f90:1318-1340). The numpf=1 branch keeps dtp1 + dtp2 = dt = 3*dtt. Unchanged on upstream master d4e0a86898010f9453453d868d197d3f40a8f1c8.
dt_over_3.observed_effect: For numpf=1 the pinned result is exactly three times the linear interpolation of the prepared point members (all nonzero decoded node rows, ratio 3 within the tolerance policy). A constant 1 mm/h interval-mean sequence yields prepared members of 1 mm/h and an interpol_rain result of 3 mm/h at every admitted time.
dt_over_3.upstream_compensation: None found. darain preserves a constant series; the reader applies no scaling to GRIB1 LSP/CP.
dt_over_3.physical_meaning: None established. The factor is frozen pinned behaviour shared from the numpf=3 path, not an amount-to-rate conversion and not evidence of a one-third interval.
dt_over_3.policy: #119 must reproduce the pinned arithmetic exactly, including the factor. No removal or compensation is authorized.

accepted_input_representation.quantity: flex_extract RRINT=0 reconstructed precipitation rate at member time T (LSP and CP separately)
accepted_input_representation.producer: #207 GPU reconstruction from #90 interval means, or an equivalent prepared member with the provenance below
not_accepted: #90 interval-mean rate assigned to either interval endpoint
flex_extract leading persistence value (first padded flux file = its own interval mean)
flex_extract BASETIME trailing values (T_last - DTIME duplicates T_last - 2*DTIME; T_last carries a raw interval mean)

member_mapping.delta: Δ = DTIME, a positive integer number of hours, equal for all support intervals
member_mapping.flexpart_memtime: T (AVAILABLE entry must equal T; FLEXPART does not verify)

temporal_coverage.interval_sequence: N >= 5 contiguous intervals (s_0, s_0+Δ], ..., (s_0+(N-1)Δ, s_0+NΔ] with one source/grid/context identity
temporal_coverage.member_times: T_j = s_0 + jΔ for j = 2 .. N-2 (each with four-interval support)
temporal_coverage.admitted_itime: T_first <= itime <= T_last, forward time direction, with at least two members

boundary_policies.first: itime = T_first uses pair (T_first, T_first+Δ) with dt1 = 0; pinned result 3*r(T_first).
boundary_policies.interior: T_j < itime < T_{j+1} uses pair (T_j, T_{j+1}) (getfields_mod.f90:159-160, left-inclusive, right-exclusive).
boundary_policies.exact_interior_boundary: itime = T_j (j > first): the real caller rotates to pair (T_j, T_{j+1}) with dt1 = 0; result 3*r(T_j). Observed at T_j = 75600 s: oracle cases interior_left (dt2 = 0) and interior (dt1 = 0) return identical LSP and CP.
boundary_policies.last: itime = T_last: the real caller rotates memtime(1) = memtime(2) = T_last (getfields_mod.f90:167-203) and interpol_rain takes the duplicate-time branch (dt = 1, dt2 = 1, dtt = 1/3); result 3*r(T_last), oracle case final_duplicate_time.
boundary_policies.extrapolation: The raw routine extrapolates linearly outside [memtime(1), memtime(2)] (oracle rows at -3600 s and +3600 s). The real caller terminates instead (getfields_mod.f90:150-156, nstop = 4). Canonical admission rejects itime < T_first or itime > T_last.
boundary_policies.duplicate_time: Admitted only as the representation of itime = T_last. Any other duplicate member time is rejected.
boundary_policies.backward: ldirect = -1 is not established by this evidence and is rejected.

rejections.reason: #90 interval mean supplied where a reconstructed point member is required
fewer than two supporting intervals before or after a member time, or N < 5
intervals of different length, or Δ not a positive integer number of hours (DTIME is used as int hours, EcFlexpart.py:1068,1138,1143)
consecutive member times not separated by Δ
LSP or CP member missing at a required time
source, grid, context, unit or provenance identity differs between members or from the request
NaN or infinite interval mean or member
RRINT=1, PUREFC=1, BASETIME trailing values, leading persistence value, unknown preparation, or numpf != 1
duplicate member time other than the itime = T_last caller state

fixture_audit.rain-layer-fields (fixtures/interpolatio: Arithmetic golden only. It injects already-prepared members at memory times [0, 3600] without preparation provenance; unaffected by this decision.

reasons: It assigns interval means directly to memory times; flex_extract RRINT=0 never emits an interior interval mean as a member.
It assigns (0, 1800] to memory time 0, the start of that interval; no flex_extract path stamps an interval mean at its start.
It assigns (1800, 3600] to memory time 3600, which only matches the excluded BASETIME trailing write.
Δ = 1800 s is not an integer number of hours and cannot be a flex_extract DTIME.
Two intervals cannot provide the four-interval support of any member.
rain-layer-fields-bilinear-rates (fixtur.status: The 159.75 / 3.0 mm/h golden remains a valid pinned-arithmetic regression. It is not evidence for the interval-to-member mapping and must not be used as #119 production-path evidence.

compatibility_with_90.equivalent_quantity: The #90 interval-mean mm/h rate and flex_extract deac_vals describe the same quantity for the same interval when both start from the same accumulated sequence; proving numerical equivalence is a #207 obligation.
compatibility_with_90.missing_operation: flex_extract RRINT=0 darain four-interval point-rate reconstruction, stamped at the interval boundary T (#207).
compatibility_with_90.not_missing: No timestamp shift, amount scaling or dt/3 compensation is required or permitted.

handoff_119.typed_input: ordered members {T, lsp_mm_per_h, cp_mm_per_h, delta_seconds, support_start = T - 2Δ, support_end = T + 2Δ, preparation = flex_extract-7.1.2-rrint0-darain, source/grid/context identity}
handoff_119.sampler: for admitted itime, select (T_j, T_{j+1}) as in boundary_policies and evaluate the pinned formula with dtt = dt/3 exactly; at itime = T_last evaluate the duplicate-time branch
handoff_119.output: time-sampled LSP and CP in mm/h, as interpol_rain yint1/yint2
handoff_119.evidence: pinned interpol_rain comparison at first, interior, exact boundary and last times with the #71 tolerance policy; actual device execution; complete negative matrix from rejections
handoff_119.no_new_semantics: #119 may not add a timestamp shift, rescaling, reconstruction or tolerance

rejected_assumptions: RRINT=0 is equivalent to numpf=1 merely because both select one member: replaced by the proven reader/writer relationship above.
A prepared member equals a #90 interval mean: refuted; most nonzero interior members differ from both adjacent interval means.
dt/3 converts an interval amount or encodes a one-third interval: no source support; it is the numpf=3 sub-interval width.
An upstream preparation step divides by three: refuted for darain (constant series preserved) and the GRIB1 reader.
The accumulation fixture's 20-minute lead/offset reading of dtt: not original preprocessing; its derived intervals are 1800 s.
Interval starts, ends or centres are FLEXPART member timestamps: the member time is the darain reconstruction time T, the boundary between the second and third support intervals.
GRIB date/time constrains FLEXPART memory time: FLEXPART uses AVAILABLE only.
out_of_scope_observations: RRINT=1 file stamped T carries IA3 values at T-Δ, T-2Δ/3 and T-Δ/3 (observed), while interpol_rain numpf=3 places submembers at memtime, memtime+dt/3 and memtime+2dt/3. A numpf=3 issue must resolve this one-interval offset before use.
The GRIB2 CP path divides by conversion_factor = 1000 (windfields_mod.f90:2140-2147); this decision covers GRIB1 flex_extract output only.
ERA5 class EA skips deaccumulation (EcFlexpart.py:1136-1138); its accumulation convention is not exercised here.
